Patches the runtime trust store against the eMudhra intermediate-CA
compromise. No application code changes and no migration — pull the new image
and recreate the container.

## What happened

Eight eMudhra intermediate certificates were compromised through weak key
generation, and every major root program distrusted them in October 2026. Any
TLS client still trusting those intermediates can be impersonated by anyone
holding the recovered keys.

## What changed

- Base image pinned to `node:22.23.4-alpine`. That Node release carries the
  corrected CA bundle, and rebuilding pulls Alpine's fixed `ca-certificates`,
  so both layers of the image trust store are clean.
- Local toolchain pin matches: `mise.toml` now resolves Node `22.23.4`, so a
  fresh `mise install` reproduces exactly the runtime CI tests against.

The dashboard, pipeline, and database are untouched. Schema changes remain
additive, and existing pipeline rows are unaffected.

## Upgrading

Pull the new image and recreate the container. If you run the frontend from a
local checkout rather than the image, run `mise install` to pick up Node
`22.23.4`.
